description: Categorical plausibility: is a chemical element's labelled phase-at-STP physically plausible? A vocabulary check passes any value in {solid, liquid, gas}; only world knowledge catches mercury labelled 'solid'. This mirrors the auditor's labels.py check (it reuses build_label_prompt), demonstrated on an elements fixture because both shipped flagships leave label_rules empty.
domain_context: Phase of a pure chemical element at standard temperature and pressure (STP: about 25 C and 1 atm). At STP every element is one of solid, liquid, or gas.
